verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a built-in AI assistant inside GoDaddy. It documents an MCP server that external AI assistants can call and a gddy agent skill that lets a third-party AI coding agent run CLI commands for the user. Both rely on an outside agent rather than an assistant inside the product, so they are adjacent integration points and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
